annotations.text: Sweep 2026-10-04: the seven listing page types (occasion hub, category hub, occasions index, destinations hub, country shop, country category, country occasion) have new first screens, the country guide's first screen lost its empty photo slot, and the language popup replaces the root chooser and the suggestion strip. See docs/design/audits/2026-10-04-site-sweep.md. v2 (2026-10-03, founder-locked): redrawn in the letter-home look — home, the country shop root, country category, country occasion, the two hubs, the occasions index, the destinations hub, the country guide, the product page, not-found and the chrome. Spec 041 (2026-10-04) redrew how it works, the guarantee with delivery and payment, help and contact, about, the legal template and the cookie register. The rest (locale chooser, checkout, confirmation, track, for florists, blog) are still drawn in v1 and are redrawn by the task that next builds them. wireframes — one desktop (1440) and one mobile (390) artboard per Phase 0 page type, in buyer-journey order. Round 2 (TASK-059, 2026-09-09): every page reworked against docs/design/benchmarks/. Spec 008 added the six listing and hub artboards; spec 009's round rebuilds product-desktop and product-mobile around the three date-picker states — unavailable, preview and live — and takes the countdown, the relative “today” chip, the Continue button, the add-on checkboxes, the withdrawal notice and the photo-on-delivery promise out of them. benchmarks/README.md records what each page type took and dropped, and the questions left for the founder.

Home · v2 (the letter home) — desktop 1440 and mobile 390. Direction A's layout in direction C's colours, locked by the founder 2026-10-03. Supersedes homepage-v1/homepage-{desktop,mobile}, which stay as the 2026-09-08 record.
Chrome · v2 — notice bar, header and footer, every control a link to a real page or absent (spec 004 §14 A20, spec 008 §14 A14).
Locale chooser — desktop 1440 and mobile 390. Reworked in round 2 against docs/design/benchmarks/ (see benchmarks/README.md for what this page type took and dropped).

Our guarantee and Delivery and payment — two trust pages on one template, desktop 1440 and mobile 390: the fresh-flower promise (72 hours, no number of days), the seven-country table with each state, no payment method until one is available.

Version header, draft lines, contents, change log; the imprint and the gated documents as states. The document text is spec 041 batch 2, so it is slotted.

The register table from src/config/cookies.ts, Change cookie settings, and until the privacy notice exists the two interim sections; the consent banner's controller sentence as a state.

Language popup (sweep 2026-10-04) — the founder's ruling replaces the / chooser with one fixed redirect to /en and this first-visit popup; the old “Would you rather read this page in English?” strip goes. Desktop card, 390 top sheet (ruling R10).
Spec 011 (2026-10-05) · For florists: how an order reaches you (walkthrough). Desktop 1440 and mobile 390; the four screens are the real inbox components in phone frames. Founder copy pending.
Spec 011 · Apply and sent: the form (no upload, no bank details), what happens next, the notice at collection; errors, send failed, too many, form off, the sent page.
Spec 011 · Florist sign-in: the one email link on spec 012's shared core; request, check your email, confirm, expired, the email.
Spec 011 · Florist inbox v0 (/demo/vendor-inbox on staging): list, every order stage with only the allowed action, the photo step. Phone first: minimal header, 56 px docked actions.
Spec 012 · Admin v0 · sign-in (shared core, admin instance). Every admin artboard: desktop-first and dense, works at 390. Founder copy pending; English only.
Spec 012 · Admin · Today: three counters, navigation per role, zero state, 403 and 404.
Spec 012 · Admin · Orders (read only): filters, the 3 s live check and its pause, demo marker, new-arrival highlight, empty and filtered-empty.
Spec 012 · Admin · One order: lines and VAT, recipient by role, the event timeline with raw payloads, assignments, payments. No action panel in v0 (spec 020).
Spec 012 · Admin · Flags: checkout.open per country, checkout.demo_guard with the typed-key confirmation, an orphaned key.
Spec 012 · Admin · Florists: list by status.
Spec 012 · Admin · One florist: profile, terms, zones, days off, products and payouts; status with the missing conditions (Make active absent until all are met); demo florist.
Spec 012 · Admin · Applications: list, one application, mark contacted, convert, reject with a reason.
Spec 012 · Admin · Audit log: filters, before/after diff with masked values.
Spec 012 · Admin · Users: roles, deactivate, your own last admin role.
Spec 016 · Emails · the layout: buyer, florist and founder frames, and the parts every template is built from.

Spec 016 · Emails · buyer B1 to B8: we have your order (charged at once), being made, on its way, delivered with the photo, cancelled, refund, payment refused, invoice and credit note. Plain text beside each.
Spec 016 · Emails · florist V1 to V5: offer, reminder, confirmed, stop, photo reminder. One-tap link; no recipient data.
Spec 016 · Emails · founder: the no-florist alert with the grace window, and the WhatsApp copies (offer and stop message) to paste.

TASK-252 · QA judgments of 2026-10-18, awaiting founder: cookie card placement, cookie settings length, the phone Menu, Esc, the phone Popular choices row, short screens, the listing card, static add-on rows. Answer each with one word (1A, 2B...).

Founder ruling 2026-10-19 (A-founder-2026-10-19d): no cookie banner while only essential cookies are set, the compact banner when analytics is on, the settings panel from the footer; the language popup's future slim one-line bar.

Spec 012b · Admin catalogue CMS, slice A (2026-10-20). Products, one product, price change, photos, photo review, countries, one country, publish; and the two flows. Every new string is a [slot] (dotted underline).

Spec 012b · Admin · Catalogue: every product with its text review per language, photos, Polish price, placeholder and waiting-to-publish chips; empty, filtered empty, backup warning. Dotted underline = [slot] copy.

Spec 012b · Admin · One product: details with the florist who makes it, sizes with the florist’s price, text per language with Approve, photos with alt text, prices, margin with the suggested price; every rule state.

Spec 012b · Admin · Price change: type the all-in price, then see it in en, en-gb, de, pl, the per cent change, the 30-day lowest; the ±30 % warning, same-day refusal, florist’s share above 65 %, below the florist’s price.
Spec 012b · Admin · Photos: the grid, upload with provenance by source (florist, AI, stock), progress, making sizes, every refusal.
Spec 012b · Admin · One photo: the four checks, Approve or Reject through the ledger; approved, rejected, florist without terms, imported not re-read.
Spec 012b · Admin · Countries: status, first live, real florists, priced and buyable products, what the go-live check still needs. Operations editing is later (§13 Q16).
Spec 012b · Admin · One country: the go-live check with named reasons, Go live with the typed code, live with what no longer holds, back to demo.
Spec 012b · Admin · Publish: pages added and removed per language, one Publish button, building, live and checked, failed, timed out, daily limit, indexable removals refused, Railway only.

Spec 044 · Blog index and blog post, desktop 1440 and mobile 390 (2026-10-21): posts written and approved in admin. Index: a ruled list newest first, no lead story. Post: byline, Published and Updated, the not-open line, cover and AI note, excerpt, the body subset, one end link to the guide of the first country tag. Replaces the round 2 shared pair.

Spec 044 · Admin · One blog post: write with the checks card, insert a link to our pages, preview, approve the exact text, Publish post (a rebuild), live and checked, edit by revision and Publish changes (no rebuild), unpublish. The preview is a state of this page.
Spec 044 · Admin · Blog posts: every post with its status chip (draft, awaiting approval, published, changes waiting, unpublished), filtered by status and country, empty.

Spec 044 · Admin · Blog authors: real people who agreed to be named, their own-name confirmation (theirs alone), a name change clearing it, withdrawal unpublishing their posts; public author pages by number from slice B.

Basket and customer accounts, 2026-10-22 (spec 010 and spec 018, A-founder-2026-10-22): the basket page, the account pages and the two account emails. The basket's checkout, confirmation, product and header changes are the 2026-10-22 sections at the foot of those artboards.
Spec 030a · Admin · Payouts: the five groups (open, ready to send, sent, exported, paid), open adjustments, delivered without a photo, the Wise export selection, every empty state and dialog.
Spec 030a · Admin · One payout: lines with a review flag, add a line, each refusal of Send statement as text, sent with the PDF, exported, paid.
Spec 030a · Admin · One Wise export: rows, the total per currency, download, mark paid, cancel; and the florist payout statement PDF (A4).
Spec 022a · The review form: preselected star, every state (no star, keyboard, missing rating, too long, sending, thanks, already received, expired or not found, opt-out).
Spec 022a · The reviews page: summary, star filter, cards, pages, withheld and reply cards, the 404 and noindex rules. Placeholders only: no review exists yet.
Spec 022a · Admin · Reviews: the queue with the exit metric, one review with publish, publish without text, remove, reply, and their states.
